title: AI Conversation Meta (GET /ai/conversations/:id/meta) — v2
description:
v2 adds one optional field, `title` — the name the user gave the conversation. It stays additive: `required` is unchanged, so a v1-shaped payload is still valid. The deliberate shape of this view is untouched — it still carries no message text, neither `messages` nor `summary` (summary is a content digest; including it would break "cite first, no full text"). Reading the body still requires an explicit GET /ai/conversations/:id. Permissions stay the same as conversation-data (admin or owner).

v2 只加一个**可选**字段 `title`（用户给会话起的名字）。仍是加性变更：`required` 不变，故 v1 形态的载荷仍然合法。本视图刻意保持的形状不变——仍**不含任何消息文本**，既无 `messages` 也无 `summary`（summary 是内容摘要，含它即破坏「引用优先、不落全文」）。要看正文仍须显式请求 GET /ai/conversations/:id。权限与 conversation-data 同源（admin 或 owner）。来源：src/ai/conversation/conversation.service.ts getConversationMeta；v1 冻结历史见 schemas/v1/conversation-meta.schema.json。

userId.description: 归属用户（审计归因的「谁」；username 由前端沿用审计行的快照列）

messageCount.description: 消息条数（结构信息，不含内容）

title.description: 工作账本：用户命名的会话标题（未设时字段缺席）

lastActivityAt.description: 末条消息时间（时间跨度末端）
